model_annotations.English: This vertical bar chart illustrates the "Sensitivity" of sequential numerical categories labeled "Block Index," differentiated into two distinct classifications. The horizontal axis contains the categories, arranged sequentially from left to right in ascending numerical order, with numeric tick labels positioned at 0, 15, 31, 47, and 63. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale, featuring major tick labels at 10⁻⁵ and 10⁻⁴, along with minor tick marks between and outside these intervals, and horizontal dashed grid lines aligning with the major ticks. The axis covers a visible value range extending from approximately 10⁻⁶ to just below 10⁻³. The chart features a single vertical bar for each block index from 0 to 63. A legend in the upper left corner defines the color coding of the bars: "4-Fbit" is represented by blue, and "2-Fbit" is represented by green. Visually, the green "2-Fbit" bars are predominantly located on the left and middle sections of the horizontal axis (roughly indices 0 through 52), while the blue "4-Fbit" bars appear intermittently in the middle section and consecutively populate the rightmost section (indices 53 through 63). The shortest bar on the chart is a green "2-Fbit" bar near index 4, corresponding to a sensitivity value of approximately 2 × 10⁻⁶. The tallest bar is a blue "4-Fbit" bar at index 62, reaching a peak value of approximately 4 × 10⁻⁴. Visually, the bar heights exhibit an overall upward trajectory from left to right across the block indices. Beyond the legend-defined color coding, the chart does not contain any additional visual emphasis, such as outlining, shading, or distinct annotations.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity across various sequentially numbered units, categorized by two different precision levels. The horizontal axis represents the "Block Index," arranged in sequential numerical order from left to right, with specific numeric tick labels provided at 0, 15, 31, 47, and 63. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately $2 \times 10^{-6}$ to slightly above $3 \times 10^{-4}$. This axis features major numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at $10^{-5}$ and $10^{-4}$, alongside minor unlabelled tick marks. The chart displays individual vertical bars for each block index, with a legend indicating that blue bars represent the "4-Fbit" category and green bars represent the "2-Fbit" category. The bars are neither grouped nor stacked; instead, a single bar is plotted for each block index along the horizontal axis, colored according to its assigned category. Green 2-Fbit bars predominantly occupy the lower block indices from 0 upwards, while blue 4-Fbit bars appear intermittently in the middle section and exclusively populate the highest indices ending at 63. The shortest bar in the chart is a green 2-Fbit bar located near block index 5, with an approximate value of $2 \times 10^{-6}$. Conversely, the tallest bar is a blue 4-Fbit bar located at block index 62, reaching a peak value of approximately $3 \times 10^{-4}$. The data is sorted sequentially by the block index along the horizontal axis, and there are no visually emphasized bars, outlines, or specific annotations beyond the standard color coding.
